Open it on your phone and scroll slowly. It opens on your sunlit yoga hall with Guruji's portrait, then walks along the rope wall, the wooden props and your library with a short line at each, ending with a button to ask about joining a class on WhatsApp.

Why this matters now: AI search. More and more people skip Google and simply ask ChatGPT, Gemini or Google's AI answers for “a yoga class in Velachery”. These assistants recommend the businesses whose websites clearly tell them who you are, where you are and what you offer. Most websites built a few years ago weren't made for this. Your new website is built for it: your details are written in the standard format AI tools read (schema.org), it has a clear question-and-answer section, and an llms.txt file made for AI assistants.
